silhouette.reason: From the new street-level hero the block reads as dense brick tenements: water tanks, bulkheads, fire escapes and cornices break the roofline; the cornices are thin and parapets mostly level.
fixes: deeper projecting cornices (0.4–0.6 m) and parapets of varied height on each building

proportions.reason: Storey heights vary between buildings and the street trees are taller now; roofs within each row are still the same slab height in FRONT/SIDE, and the trees are thin-trunked faceted crowns.
fixes: vary roof heights within each row
street trees with spreading irregular crowns and thicker trunks

materials.reason: Brick tones vary per building, windows read as framed grids, the asphalt has centre dashes and edge lines, and the sidewalk is laid in slabs; the tree crowns now carry faint lighter leaf streaks but stay faceted single masses, and the roofs remain one flat colour each.
fixes: patches, gravel and vents on each roof membrane
leaf-clump variation in the tree crowns

detail.reason: Fire escapes, water tanks, green cornice trims, window sills and storefront awnings now show at street level; many ground floors are still dark blank bands without doors or shop windows.
fixes: storefront glazing and doors on every street-facing ground floor

wear.reason: Faint darker patches in the asphalt and some tone variation, but the facades are clean: no grime gradient at street level, no soot under cornices, no patched roofs.
fixes: grime gradient at street level and soot streaks below cornices
patched roof membranes in varied greys

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 facades now keep their per-building red-brown brick, brownstone and pale stucco with the window grids, so the grey pop is gone; the rooftop water tanks and fire escapes drop out, so the roofline flattens at the switch.
fixes: keep the water tanks at LOD2 as one low-poly cylinder + cone each so the roofline survives the switch

technical.reason: QA clean; 60k / 13k / 5.6k triangles, 1 draw: LOD1 now drops to ~22% of LOD0.
fixes: LOD2 at 5.6k could drop window insets to sit near 3k
